Volume 3 is the third of four omnibus volumes of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. It was published by Shogakukan Asia in , although it uses VIZ Media's translation. This volume contains all the chapters originally found in and .
